email.subject1: a signal play for Remodel Health
email.body1:
TJ, saw Remodel Health raised over $100M and posted 69 percent year-over-year new business growth as the largest ICHRA administrator by ARR.

Growth like that usually means more in-market broker and employer accounts than your Central team can cover, and that is where good-fit deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Remodel Health off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
TJ, quick follow-up for Remodel Health.

With 69 percent new business growth, quota expectations grow faster than your selling capacity can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number in a region, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your Central region needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
TJ, last bit of proof for Remodel Health.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Remodel Health's reply rate likely compares to other high-growth health-tech firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
TJ, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling Central region pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing right after a raise is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a health-tech BD motion? I will tailor it to Remodel Health either way.
